d3d8to9 - a Direct3D 8 to Direct3D 9 translator, compiled INTO generalszh.exe (x64 Windows only) for the
compatibility-graphics path: a PC with no Vulkan driver renders through Windows' own d3d9.dll instead of DXVK.

Upstream:  https://github.com/crosire/d3d8to9
Tag:       v1.16.0
Commit:    255338f698c8270b537f0a91a13f795f4f988250
Tarball:   https://github.com/crosire/d3d8to9/archive/255338f698c8270b537f0a91a13f795f4f988250.tar.gz
Tarball sha256: 06e4fdedb4bc45abed1a624ebafd7e79322def09ce1a7542e65acfe400fbfc53
Licence:   BSD-2-Clause (LICENSE.md, verbatim), Copyright (C) 2015 Patrick Mours

Vendored: source/ (all 16 files) and LICENSE.md, byte-identical to the tarball, then the patches in patches/ applied in
name order. scripts/test/d3d8to9-pin-test.sh re-derives upstream + patches == source/ from the tarball.

Patches (patches/, applied in name order; each is a plain git diff of source/):
  0001-gx-entry-system-d3d9-no-log-no-box   entry point gx_d3d8to9_Direct3DCreate8 (gx_d3d8to9.h), nothing exported;
                                           System32\d3d9.dll by full path (System32-only dependency search); no log file,
                                           message box or browser; d3dx9_43.dll optional, from System32 only
  0002-gx-x64-handle-tables                 shader handles and state-block tokens as table slots (gx_handle_table.hpp):
                                           upstream stored 64-bit pointers in 32-bit DWORD handles
  0003-gx-shaders-without-d3dx             pixel shaders pass through, vertex shaders get their dcl inputs
                                           (gx_shader_tokens.cpp, adapted from DXVK's D3D8 front end, zlib notice kept)
  0004-gx-copyrects-and-caps-without-d3dx  CopyRects into managed / out of render-target surfaces by locking (fonts,
                                           screenshots) with D3DX only as a fallback; shader versions in the caps never
                                           above what the device has
  0005-gx-ps-end-inside-data              a pixel shader's END is looked for only between instructions: an END-valued comment
                                           payload or def literal no longer cuts the shader short
